# Pharmacy page fixtures

Real pages, captured on 2026-11-23 for the five pilot retailers (`docs/PHARMACY_VALIDATION.md`). Each folder
has the site's `robots.txt` and one product page that carries a JSON-LD `Product`.

The pages are trimmed copies: `<style>`, `<svg>`, inline JavaScript, HTML comments and inline base64
pictures were removed; JSON blocks (JSON-LD and the like) and the visible HTML are as the site sent them.
Adam's page body is 2 MB of filter and menu markup, so its fixture keeps the `<head>` and every JSON block
only. Nothing here is invented or edited.
